data.long_meaning: The name Farrison is derived from the Old English words 'Farra' and 'Son'. It originally meant 'Far-traveler's son'. In a broader sense, it can be interpreted as 'son of a traveler' or 'son of a journey'. In the context of Christianity, it could symbolize a spiritual journey or pilgrimage. The name Farrison carries the meaning “Far-traveler's son” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Farrison usually hope their child will grow to embody far-traveler's son and live with faith, good character and purpose.
